name: name
description: Extracts the video production title from Film.OneSentence (truncated to 100 chars), falling back to Archetype.Name or 'Video Production'

name: description
description: Extracts the production purpose from Film.Purpose

name: archetype
description: Extracts the video archetype name from Archetype.Name

name: durationSeconds
description: Extracts the target runtime in seconds from Film.DurationSeconds

name: formats
description: Extracts the target aspect ratio formats from Film.Formats

name: asOf
description: Extracts the frozen data snapshot timestamp from DataSnapshot.AsOf

name: displayMarkdown
description: Builds a markdown summary of the VideoGenerationSpec including one-sentence heading, archetype, duration, formats, status, data as-of timestamp, and generated asset count
